description: This file defines the class 'Root' within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace. The 'Root' class extends 'Directory' and manages configuration, active node, and path information for a documentation tree structure.

classes.name: Root
classes.description: Represents the root directory node in a documentation tree, manages configuration and active node state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Root object with a given Config object, setting its path and URI based on the documentation directory.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the Config object used by this Root node.

methods.name: isHotPath
methods.description: Determines if a given node is on the 'hot path' relative to the active node.

methods.name: setActiveNode
methods.description: Sets the current active node in the tree.
